# Welcome to Incorta Latest Release Documentation

Learn how to acquire, enrich, analyze, and act on data using the latest Incorta **Cloud** and **On-Premises** releases starting **2024.1.0**.

[![guides icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/AntIcon168-0b63ac385585bf35c1679729d9d71181.png)**Guides**  **Walk-throughs to install, start, analyze, administer, migrate, secure, and upgrade your Incorta cluster**](https://docs.incorta.com/latest/guides-all) [![concepts icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/AntIcon6-f2a9d4e9694665647ef7863b266acea5.png)**Concepts**  **In-depth explanations of concepts and terminology related to Incorta**](https://docs.incorta.com/latest/concepts-all) [![tools icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/AntIcon63-1d34202b276d86411033ba08054e8d94.png)**Tools**  **Learn about various tools, features, and related functionality**](https://docs.incorta.com/latest/tools-all) [![references icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/AntIcon115-694333127af4150d74eb80878668c888.png)**References**  **Detailed descriptions of built-in functions, connectors, visualizations, and more**](https://docs.incorta.com/latest/references-all) [![integrations icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/AntIcon232-9eaeba87b21f796fba3507806bf0b4bd.png)**Integrations**  **Connect your Incorta cluster to external third-party tools and applications**](https://docs.incorta.com/latest/integrations-all) [![blueprints icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/AntIcon113-d1c3327aea17a690083b0d9668e27527.png)**Data Apps**  **Pre-built content for critical enterprise systems, data, and uses cases**](https://docs.incorta.com/latest/blueprints-all) [![releases icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/AntIcon163-bd46aebedf768bad725350f042512645.png)**Release Notes**  **Notes for this release and related maintenance packs**](https://docs.incorta.com/latest/releases) [![Past releases icon](https://docs.incorta.com/static/UpdatedAntIcon200-03cfbe913f339e359c7766c3c6144b92.png)**Earlier Releases**  **Access documentation for older On-Premises and Cloud releases**](https://docs.incorta.com/home/all-docs)
